$comment: Tuned for the standalone TypeScript package. Source, tests, release scripts, manifests, and registry artifacts remain visible; generated build output and local installs stay out of the map.

subsystems.note: The generated TypeScript table and published JSON contract are parallel artifacts produced from source comments; codemap cannot follow generation or detect an output-only fixture override. The contract test exercises both equality and the fail-closed override path.
Composable source directories must match barrel exports, package exports, bundle inputs, and SSR rows by name; these are manifest and directory couplings with no import edge for the graph to resolve.
Release safety joins manifest identity, exact tag, registry state, tarball contents, consumer installation, npm configuration, and workflow permissions without import edges.
